properties.displayName: [Baseline] Storage accounts should only accept secure transfer (HTTPS)
properties.description: Denies creation or update of storage accounts that do not enforce HTTPS-only traffic. Secure transfer protects data in transit from interception and man-in-the-middle attacks. API versions from 2019-04-01 onward default this to enabled, so the rule only flags accounts that omit the property on older API versions or set it to false explicitly.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a storage account does not enforce HTTPS-only traffic.
